title: Vega-Fafnir: Is Greedy Decoding the Same Decoding? Where Rounding Noise in Speculative Verification Comes From and What Removing It Costs
abstract: arXiv:2611.27554v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Serving engines treat the ways of running a greedy language model as interchangeable: cached or not, padded or not, alone or batched, one token or several verified at once (speculative decoding). In finite precision they round differently. We measure how often the greedy text of Qwen3-0.6B (bfloat16, 128 new tokens, GSM8K and ARC prompts) differs from a reference that decodes one token per pass. Verifying 4 guessed tokens per pass changes 60% of 150 prompts and padding changes 68%; every first divergence has a top-1 minus top-2 logit gap of 0.375 or less. A split of the noise shows that cache entries written by multi-token passes are about as noisy as the multi-token pass itself. A margin gate (fall back to one token when the gap is below a bound calibrated on separate GSM8K prompts) whose fallback reads that cache does not help: 58 of 100 prompts differ, against 61 of 100 for plain verification. Rebuilding the cache with one-token passe

translated_title: Vega-Fafnir：贪心解码还是同一种解码吗？投机验证中的舍入噪声从何而来，消除它需要付出什么代价
translated_abstract: 服务引擎将运行贪心语言模型的各种方式视为可互换的：有无缓存、有无填充、单独运行还是批量运行、一次验证一个词元还是同时验证多个词元（投机解码）。在有限精度下，它们的舍入方式各不相同。我们测量了 Qwen3-0.6B（bfloat16，生成 128 个新词元，使用 GSM8K 和 ARC 提示）的贪心文本与每次只解码一个词元的参考实现之间出现差异的频率。每次验证 4 个猜测词元会改变 150 个提示中的 60%，填充会改变 68%；每一处首次分歧的 top-1 与 top-2 logit 差距都不超过 0.375。对噪声的分解表明，由多词元前向传播写入的缓存条目与多词元前向传播本身具有几乎相同的噪声水平。一种裕量门控方法（当差距低于在独立 GSM8K 提示上校准的界限时回退到单词元解码），即使其回退路径读取该缓存也无济于事：100 个提示中有 58 个出现差异，而普通验证为 100 个中的 61 个。用单词元前向传播重建缓存……
tldr: 该论文量化了贪心解码在不同执行方式下的舍入噪声：投机验证改变 60%、填充改变 68% 的提示输出，且首分歧处 logit 差距均不超过 0.375，噪声主要来自多词元前向传播写入的 KV 缓存条目，而基于裕量门控的回退策略无法消除噪声，重建缓存则需付出额外代价。
en_tdlr: The paper quantifies rounding-noise-induced divergence in greedy decoding across serving modes—speculative verification changes 60% and padding changes 68% of outputs, with noise traced mainly to KV-cache entries written by multi-token passes—and shows that a margin-gate fallback fails to remove the noise while rebuilding the cache with single-token passes comes at a cost.
